visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a close-up of a young toddler lying on a light-colored pillow, wearing a black and white striped shirt. A hand enters from the bottom left holding three fingers together to simulate a microphone. A yellow "Q:" graphic appears in the corner. (2) The child responds with various facial expressions, smiling and looking directly at the camera. Animated graphics including an Earth icon, floating pink hearts, and colorful "LOVE" letters appear around his head as he speaks. (3) The child sits up slightly, continuing to gesture with his hands while looking off-camera. Icons of bread, a strawberry, and cartoonish depictions of angry bosses and new parents are overlaid on the screen in sequence. (4) The child takes a dark-colored bead bracelet and stretches it over his eyes like a pair of glasses, smiling widely with his teeth showing. The video concludes with a prompt graphic for leaving comments while the child continues to laugh and move.
